mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE /* 1. 复用正向逻辑：取已审核+有效+最新版本，并用 son_no='1' 锚定 */ bom_latest AS ( SELECT t.* FROM `清洗_物料清单主数据` t INNER JOIN ( SELECT `father_id`, MAX(`bom_ver`) AS max_ver FROM `清洗_物料清单主数据` WHERE `data_status` = '已审核' AND is_valid = 1 GROUP BY `father_id` ) lv ON t.`father_id` = lv.`father_id` AND t.`bom_ver` = lv.max_ver WHERE t.`data_status` = '已审核' AND t.is_valid = 1 AND t.`son_no` = '1' ), /* 2. 反查递归树：分离编码与路径，避免截断 */ where_used_tree AS ( -- 锚定：查询物料本身（层级0） SELECT 0 AS level_no, CAST(#{sonId} AS CHAR(100)) AS current_code, (SELECT m.material_name FROM `清洗_物料主数据` m WHERE m.material_id = #{sonId} LIMIT 1) AS current_name, CAST(#{sonId} AS CHAR(2000)) AS path UNION ALL -- 递归：子找父（限制递归深度 9，覆盖6层展示+防护） SELECT w.level_no + 1, CAST(TRIM(t.`father_id`) AS CHAR(100)), (SELECT m.material_name FROM `清洗_物料主数据` m WHERE m.material_id = TRIM(t.`father_id`) LIMIT 1), CAST(CONCAT(w.path, ' -> ', TRIM(t.`father_id`)) AS CHAR(2000)) FROM `清洗_物料清单主数据` t JOIN where_used_tree w ON TRIM(t.`son_id`) = w.current_code JOIN bom_latest l ON t.`father_id` = l.`father_id` AND t.`bom_ver` = l.`bom_ver` WHERE w.level_no < 9 AND t.`data_status` = '已审核' AND t.is_valid = 1 ) /* 3. 平铺为7列（层级0~6） */ SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN level_no = 0 THEN CONCAT(current_code, ' ', current_name) END) AS col0, MAX(CASE WHEN level_no = 1 THEN CONCAT(current_code, ' ', current_name) END) AS col1, MAX(CASE WHEN level_no = 2 THEN CONCAT(current_code, ' ', current_name) END) AS col2, MAX(CASE WHEN level_no = 3 THEN CONCAT(current_code, ' ', current_name) END) AS col3, MAX(CASE WHEN level_no = 4 THEN CONCAT(current_code, ' ', current_name) END) AS col4, MAX(CASE WHEN level_no = 5 THEN CONCAT(current_code, ' ', current_name) END) AS col5, MAX(CASE WHEN level_no = 6 THEN CONCAT(current_code, ' ', current_name) END) AS col6, '' AS bomVer FROM where_used_tree GROUP BY path ORDER BY path
